title: Version Scrubber
summary: Lets people scrub through saved versions and see exactly what a restore would change before confirming it.
description: Version timeline with the current version pinned, a word diff of exactly what a restore would change, and a second confirm step that counts words lost and gained and names changed numbers.
catches: What a restore would change, as a word diff
Words lost and gained, counted in the confirmation
Selecting the current or an identical version (nothing to restore)
Restore failures, with the current version kept
a11y: Timeline slider is labelled with aria-valuetext naming the version
Diff parts have sr-only "comes back" / "removed" prefixes
Confirm is a labelled group; Cancel gets focus; Escape closes
Errors use role=alert; summary in a polite live region
